title: Session recovery from verified checkpoints
summary: Resume interrupted work from durable, runtime-verified state, never from a transcript or a model's memory, and never replay a completed side effect.

provenance.notes: ECC persists session summaries through hooks. Here the durable scheduler state is the single source of truth and summaries are projections of it.

inputs.name: checkpoint
inputs.description: The latest durable checkpoint and its digest.

outputs.name: resume-plan
outputs.description: What is done and verified, what is pending, what is unverified, and the next safe step.

workflow.step: Load the latest checkpoint from durable storage and verify its digest against the source evidence.
workflow.check: A checkpoint whose digest does not verify is not used.

workflow.step: Classify each step: completed and verified, completed but unverified, in flight, or not started.
workflow.check: Model claims are listed as unverified, never as completed.

workflow.step: For an in-flight step, inspect the repository and records to learn what actually happened before deciding anything.
workflow.check: The decision is based on state, not on the last message.

workflow.step: Never re-run a step whose side effect is recorded as done; resume at the first step that is not.
Write the next checkpoint with a sequence number and a fingerprint so replays are idempotent.

constraints: Do not copy transcripts or credentials into checkpoints.
Compaction must be lossless for durable state: if it does not fit, fail rather than truncate.
An ambiguous in-flight state is escalated to the Lead, not guessed.

examples.title: Crash mid-edit
examples.situation: A worker died after writing one of two files.
examples.guidance: Compare the working tree with the recorded hashes, restore to the recorded state, and re-dispatch as a new run.

verification: The resume plan separates verified, unverified and pending work.
No completed side effect appears in the pending list.

task.text: Resume the interrupted task from the checkpoint after the restart; do not replay done steps.
The pre-compact summary lost the session state; recover and continue the task.
